points.statement: A lightweight all-in-one restoration method explicitly decomposes feature representations into high- and low-frequency components at each scale of a hierarchical encoder-decoder architecture.
points.quote: In this paper, we present Frequency Reconstruction via Spectral Harmonization, a novel lightweight all-in-one restoration method that explicitly decomposes feature representations into high- and low-frequency components at each scale of a hierarchical encoder-decoder architecture.

points.statement: The architecture decomposes features into high and low Fourier frequency components at each scale and processes them through specialized blocks tailored to their characteristics.
points.quote: FReSH-IR employs an asymmetric UNet [38] architecture that decomposes features into high and low Fourier frequency components at each scale and processes them through specialized blocks tailored to their characteristics.

points.statement: Combining spectral decomposition with spatial processing through Fourier-based skip connections captures complementary frequency information without sacrificing spatial detail.
points.quote: By combining spectral decomposition with spatial processing through Fourier-based skip connections, FReSH-IR captures complementary frequency information without sacrificing spatial detail.
